question: OB 8 is related to UE 3 in a certain way. In the same way, TO 11 is related to ZR 6. To which of the following is IB 8 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914456ecd02a295fcb6a97049dfda1145c674dab9f03e8a7de5db8403c4b7657.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**OB 8: UE 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/744ccda815453b0ba6b71a8f72f9e582602197bd423e78af618d8a717cd766de.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed4293016112c5f12d5a60ec84dcc39216bc612ba9b8a6c7a252bf4e96545256.png] 

**TO 11: ZR 6**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25d444f7b04cdc379803d639ea657c11903e23eb50ad871c9f3a3013c6619796.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df8eeb4bb9c008bd8fd00dfed9cfe151b55248b35ea18b268d2d79088787b3af.png] 

Similarly,

**IB 8: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d95440031afeeddcbdc08276b8c19cca56909b427470ed4ade00aa3a79ea4b72.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b2b22eae8ed34bf8d26fb258581c9687ec2b87805bfd134feccec23a58f8cb0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"OE 3"**.
